title: Inter are 25th of 36 in Europe — and Club Brugge come to San Siro on Tuesday
caption:
Inter are top of Serie A and 25th of 36 in the Champions League. Club Brugge come to San Siro on Tuesday at 3:00 PM ET. Five starters are expected back, per Sky Sport Italia via FCInterNews — Lautaro, Barella, Zieliński, Bastoni, Akanji. #Inter #InterClubBrugge #ChampionsLeague
